explainer_content.short_definition: Late-80s and early-90s rap at a creative peak: samples, lyric technique, politics, humor, and crew identity.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Golden-age hip-hop expanded the possibilities of rap records, from Public Enemy's sonic pressure to Native Tongues' jazz-colored playfulness.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It set durable standards for MC craft, production density, and album-era hip-hop seriousness.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The records sound exploratory and highly authored, as if rap's vocabulary is growing in real time.
